questions.question:
Use the clues in the sentence to decide the meaning of the word "inclement".
"The weather was so inclement that the match was cancelled; heavy rain and strong winds lashed the ground."
questions.explanation: Heavy rain and strong winds describe harsh, stormy weather.

questions.question:
Use the clues in the sentence to decide the meaning of the word "frugal".
"He was frugal; he saved every rupee and never wasted money."
questions.explanation: Saving every rupee shows care with money.

questions.question:
Use the clues in the sentence to decide the meaning of the word "lucid".
"The teacher's lucid explanation made the topic easy to understand."
questions.explanation: An explanation that makes things easy to understand is clear.

questions.question:
Use the clues in the sentence to decide the meaning of the word "reluctant".
"She was reluctant to speak; she looked at the floor and said nothing."
questions.explanation: Saying nothing shows unwillingness.

questions.question:
Use the clues in the sentence to decide the meaning of the word "frail".
"The old man was so frail that he could hardly lift a cup."
questions.explanation: Hardly being able to lift a cup shows weakness.

questions.question:
Use the clues in the sentence to decide the meaning of the word "jubilant".
"The audience was jubilant when their team won, cheering and dancing."
questions.explanation: Cheering and dancing show joy.

questions.question:
Use the clues in the sentence to decide the meaning of the word "gregarious".
"Unlike his gregarious brother, who loved parties, Anil preferred to stay alone."
questions.explanation: Loving parties contrasts with staying alone: sociable.

questions.question:
Use the clues in the sentence to decide the meaning of the word "rhetoric".
"The politician's speech was full of rhetoric, but it contained no concrete plans."
questions.explanation: But signals that the speech lacked concrete plans, so it was fine words without substance.

questions.question:
Use the clues in the sentence to decide the meaning of the word "keen".
"The detective's keen observation, noticing even the smallest detail, solved the case."
questions.explanation: Noticing the smallest detail shows sharpness.

questions.question:
Use the clues in the sentence to decide the meaning of the word "withered".
"After the long drought, the farmers were desperate; their crops had withered."
questions.explanation: A drought dries up crops.

questions.question:
Use the clues in the sentence to decide the meaning of the word "ardent".
"She was an ardent supporter of the team and attended every match."
questions.explanation: Attending every match shows passion.

questions.question:
Use the clues in the sentence to decide the meaning of the word "prudent".
"His prudent decision to save money protected him during the crisis."
questions.explanation: A decision that protected him was wise.

questions.question:
Use the clues in the sentence to decide the meaning of the word "lenient".
"The manager was lenient; he forgave the late arrivals and did not punish anyone."
questions.explanation: Forgiving and not punishing suggests leniency.

questions.question:
Use the clues in the sentence to decide the meaning of the word "formidable".
"The mountain was so formidable that few dared to climb it."
questions.explanation: Few dared to climb it, so it was frightening to face.

questions.question:
Use the clues in the sentence to decide the meaning of the word "hypothesis".
"The scientist's hypothesis, a tentative explanation yet to be tested, was published."
options: a proposed explanation to be tested
questions.explanation: The sentence itself defines it as a tentative explanation yet to be tested.

questions.question:
Use the clues in the sentence to decide the meaning of the word "ambiguous".
"Because the instructions were ambiguous, each student interpreted them differently."
options: open to more than one meaning
questions.explanation: Different interpretations suggest the instructions could be understood in more than one way.

questions.question:
Use the clues in the sentence to decide the meaning of the word "meagre".
"The company's meagre profits barely covered the salaries."
questions.explanation: Barely covering salaries shows the profits were very small.

questions.question:
Use the clues in the sentence to decide the meaning of the word "eloquent".
"Her eloquent speech, fluent and persuasive, won the audience."
questions.explanation: The sentence describes it as fluent and persuasive.

questions.question:
Use the clues in the sentence to decide the meaning of the word "animosity".
"The rivals' animosity was clear; they refused even to shake hands."
questions.explanation: Refusing to shake hands shows hostility.

questions.question:
Use the clues in the sentence to decide the meaning of the word "unprecedented".
"The sudden collapse of the market was unprecedented; nothing like it had happened before."
questions.explanation: The sentence explains it: nothing like it had happened before.
